title: The valley
creator: core
description: The valley: a river and its bay, a town on its shelf, a grove, the ruins and the hills; every road out opens by its own quest.

props.note: Bridge, fire, bell, cut in a row. Under the bell, a lantern facing the hills.
An iron lantern post, turned to the town. Paving stones at its feet.
Cut deep: "By day the rubble, by night the way."
A stone lantern, its fire bowl facing the hills, where the mist comes from. Soft earth below.

slots.label: Empty corner
slots.reserved: A player places a stall at the town's free corner (the owner's answer)

slots.reserved: The grove clearing is the traveller's ember camp (decision 35 of 22.10)
